text: どこへ　いっちまったんだか　ぜんぜん　こねえんだよ！

structure.jp: どこへ　いっちまったんだか
structure.en: who knows where she's gone off to

structure.jp: ぜんぜん　こねえんだよ！
structure.en: she just isn't coming at all!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちまう is a rough spoken form of てしまう, which says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. いっちまった = 'went and left'.

patterns.name: 〜か (uncertain)
patterns.explanation: んだか after a question word shows the speaker has no idea of the answer. どこへいっちまったんだか = 'where she has gone off to, I don't know'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねえ is a rough men's way of saying ない, 'not'. こねえ is こない = 'doesn't come'.
